body:
## Problem

Hive Mind 2.5.2 rejects the Formal AI provider before Agent CLI starts:

```text
solve ISSUE_URL --tool agent --model formal-ai
Unrecognized model: "formal-ai"
Available models for agent: ...
```

The Agent CLI itself supports `formal-ai` / `formalai/formal-ai`, and `src/agent.lib.mjs` already passes unknown model IDs through (`agentModels[model] || model`), but model validation in `src/models/index.mjs` rejects this provider alias first.

## Requested change

- Add `formal-ai` to `agentModels` (mapping to `formalai/formal-ai`) and the agent validation model map.
- Add a test proving `solve ... --tool agent --model formal-ai --only-prepare-command` reaches command preparation.

## Context

Discovered while implementing link-assistant/formal-ai#655, whose required outer loop is exactly Hive Mind → Agent CLI → `formal-ai serve --agent-mode`.
title: Allow --tool agent --model formal-ai dispatch and for all other tools also
